item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00285","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C08","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 is a clear reusable template for the child. It has the identical title and uses the same numbered, itemized machinery to designate customs ports of entry, revoke existing designations, and extend port limits by modifying named Customs Collection Districts. The child adapts that framework to different locations and adds a port renaming provision. Both directives conclude with the identical thirtieth-day effectiveness clause. C08 shares customs subject matter and a similar delayed-effective-date phrase, but its trade-agreement proclamation machinery is materially different. C16 has a numbered administrative-reorganization structure and an effectiveness clause, but concerns land offices and lacks distinctive customs-field language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Neah Bay, Washington, is designated as a customs port of entry in Customs Collection District Number 30 (Washington).","parent_excerpt":"Elkin, North Carolina, is designated as a customs port of entry in Customs Collection District No. 15 (North Carolina).","explanation":"Identical operative formula for designating a new customs port, with only the place and district changed."},{"child_excerpt":"The designation of Guayanilla, Puerto Rico, as a customs port of entry in Customs Collection District Number 49 (Puerto Rico) is revoked.","parent_excerpt":"The designations of Arecibo, Puerto Rico, and Arroyo, Puerto Rico, as customs ports of entry in Customs Collection District No. 49 (Puerto Rico) are revoked.","explanation":"The child reuses the same revocation machinery and wording, even within the same Puerto Rico customs district."},{"child_excerpt":"The limits of the customs port of entry of Lawrence, Massachusetts, in Customs Collection District Number 4 (Massachusetts) are extended to include the township of North Andover, County of Essex, State of Massachusetts.","parent_excerpt":"The limits of the customs port of entry of Alexandria Bay, New York, in Customs Collection District Number 7 (St. Lawrence), are extended to include the Township of Alexandria, County of Jefferson, State of New York...","explanation":"Both employ the same detailed formula for extending a port's territorial limits to named local subdivisions."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall become effective on the thirtieth day following the date hereof.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective on the thirtieth day following the date hereof.","explanation":"The effectiveness clause is verbatim identical and completes the same operative sequence."}]}
